regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)
note: Addressee name redacted (b)(4) in the posted PDF.

cases.claim: “DISEASE CONTROL RATE 71% of patients with a confirmed response or with SD of ≥12 weeks’ duration (95% Cl: 52%, 85.8%)” | bar showing 7% CR, 32% PR, 52% SD, 10% PD | waterfall plot “TARGET LESION CHANGES AT STUDY-END ANALYSIS (N=31)”
cases.context: Approval based on ORR (CR+PR) and DoR in single-arm AMPECT. Disclaimers: “Disease control rate was a post hoc exploratory endpoint and was not prespecified...” and “…SD and PD could be due to the natural course of the disease and not due to treatment”.
cases.rationale: Single-arm trial cannot attribute SD (alone or within DCR) to the drug; DCR is unsupported; disclaimers do not cure.
cases.check: Rule: in single-arm-trial products, flag 'stable disease' or 'disease control rate' claims; disclaimers do not count as a fix.

cases.claim: “FYARRO goes the distance for patients with PEComa” | “MEDIAN PFS” “~1 YEAR (10.6 months; 95% CI: 5.5, 41.2 months)” | “MEDIAN OS” “>4 YEARS (53.1 months; 95% CI: 22.2 months to not reached)”
cases.context: Kaplan-Meier graphs from single-arm AMPECT; footnote: “Survival data should be interpreted with caution given the single-arm study design.”
cases.rationale: Time-to-event endpoints from a single-arm trial are uninterpretable; tagline furthers implied survival benefit.
cases.check: Rule: flag PFS/OS/median-survival claims when the source trial is single-arm (pair with label 'Clinical Studies' design).
